full_prompt_en: This square editorial cartoon is a loud, hand-drawn close view of a blue skeletal figure against a magenta and orange field. A rough white border surrounds the colored image. The figure pushes in from the left and fills most of the square, with one thin blue hand splayed against the side of the head. Small oval goggles rest above the brow. One pale round eye opens wide within a heavily inked socket, while the other side of the face is reduced to dark hollows and sharp yellow ridges. The mouth gapes toward the right, exposing uneven yellow teeth along both jaws and a purple tongue inside a nearly black opening. A collar and angular shoulder shapes crowd the lower corners. The background has no natural setting: violet and hot pink scratch marks gather behind the head, while broad orange and yellow shapes flare from the right edge toward the open mouth. Thick black contour lines and vigorous hatching hold the face together despite the extreme color contrast. Cyan and deep blue define the larger masses, with lemon yellow lighting their edges and the protruding bones. Short, broken strokes, ink flecks, and rough overlaps make the surface feel quickly worked rather than polished. The brightest orange appears on the side toward which the figure cries out, creating a theatrical color clash in place of realistic illumination. A small dark signature-like scrawl sits near the lower right but is not legible as a word. The image feels frantic and comic, held together by forceful ink structure, jagged marks, and opposing cool and hot color fields.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅喧闹的方形社论漫画手绘近景，蓝色骷髅式人物处在洋红与橙色场域前。粗糙的白边围住彩色画面。人物从左侧冲入，占据方形大部，一只细长蓝手张开贴在头侧。眉上架着小小的椭圆护目镜。一只浅色圆眼在浓重墨线眼窝中睁得很大，脸的另一侧则简化为深色孔洞和尖锐的黄色骨脊。嘴朝右边大张，上下颌露出不齐的黄牙，近黑的口腔里有紫色舌头。衣领和棱角分明的肩形挤满下方两角。背景没有自然环境：紫色与亮粉的刮擦痕聚在头后，宽阔橙黄形状则从右缘向张开的嘴边喷发。厚黑轮廓与有力排线在极端色彩对比中维持面部结构。青色与深蓝界定较大体块，柠檬黄照亮边缘与突出骨形。短促断裂笔触、墨点和粗糙叠压让表面显得迅速挥就，而不追求光洁。最亮的橙色落在人物呼喊的方向，以戏剧性的色彩碰撞代替现实照明。右下附近有一小段深色签名状涂写，却不能读作清楚的词。画面狂乱而滑稽，靠强劲墨线骨架、锯齿状痕迹与冷热对立色域聚合。
style_prompt_en: Expressive cartoon drawing relies on heavy black contours, loose crosshatching, broken scratch marks, and broad saturated color patches. Cool cyan and ultramarine masses collide with hot yellow, orange, violet, and magenta; the meeting points act as flashes of theatrical light rather than natural shading. Forms are distorted by sharp angles, large openings, and uneven line weight, while a few pale focal accents stand out inside dense dark marks. White margins and rough paperlike edges keep the energetic field contained. The result is abrasive, funny, and immediate, with a strong ink skeleton beneath deliberately unruly color.
style_prompt_zh: 富表现力的漫画绘制依靠厚黑轮廓、松散交叉排线、断裂刮痕与大块饱和色。冷青和群青体块同炽热黄、橙、紫及洋红相撞；交界处像戏剧性闪光，而不是自然的阴影。尖角、大开口与不均匀线粗使形状夸张变形，少数浅色焦点从密集深痕中跳出。白色留边与粗糙纸边把充满动势的色域收在内部。效果刺目、诙谐且直接，任性色彩下仍有强健的墨线骨架。
theme_en: A startled blue skeletal cartoon figure before a burst of orange and magenta
theme_zh: 橙紫爆发色块前受惊的蓝色骷髅式漫画人物
name: Andy Marlette
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
